  Transenigma (Jan 2025 – Jun 2026)  
 
 
Client : AstraZeneca 
Role : Anaplan Model Builder (Consultant) 
 
 
Model: Sales Incentive, Commission & Sales Performance 
Planning Model 
Tools & Technologies: Anaplan (Lists, Modules, UX Dashboards), Data Hub / Spoke Architecture, 
Workflow, CloudWorks, SQL (basic), Jira 
Model Description 
Built an end-to-end sales planning solution to automate commission and incentive calculations and 
streamline pipeline, quota allocation, and attainment tracking. Delivered real-time visibility into 
payout projections, margin impact, and performance KPIs across regions, products, and sales reps, 
enabling Sales Leadership and Sales Ops to run faster and more controlled planning cycles. 
Project Contributions 
• Implemented complex payout logic supporting tiered commissions, flat-rate incentives, 
accelerators, caps/floors, and product-based eligibility rules. 
• Designed scalable model architecture using System modules for mappings (Rep → Region, 
Product → Category, Territory → Hierarchy) to ensure performance and maintainability. 
• Built interactive dashboards for quota vs attainment, pipeline tracking, and commission projections 
with drill-downs by region, product line, and rep. 
• Enabled what-if simulations for territory reassignment, quota changes, and new product launch 
impacts using scenario drivers and controlled inputs. 
• Supported reconciliation of commission outputs with HR/Finance records and improved accuracy 
through validation checks and exception reporting. 
• Integrated CRM pipeline and master data using governed import flows and ensured data quality via 
staged Data Hub loads and validations. 
• Supported UAT execution, defect triage, and deployment readiness documentation, ensuring smooth 
rollout and user adoption. 
 
 

Mohit Kumar 
 
 
 
Model: Financial Planning & Budgeting Model (FP&A) 
Tools & Technologies:  Anaplan (Modules, Data Hub, Workflow, UX Dashboards),  
Excel, SQL (basic), Jira 
Model Description 
Built a driver-based FP&A solution enabling budgeting, rolling forecasts, and variance analysis 
across business units. Improved transparency and cycle efficiency by centralizing planning inputs, 
standardizing calculation logic, and enabling multi-version comparisons for finance stakeholders. 
Project Contributions 
• Configured driver-based planning modules for Revenue, Opex, and Headcount-driven costs, 
aligning planning logic with finance assumptions and business rules. 
• Designed versioning approach to support Budget, Forecast, Actuals, and Scenario iterations, 
enabling faster reforecasting and controlled comparisons. 
• Built variance dashboards and KPI outputs for Actual vs Budget vs Forecast with drill-down 
capability by entity/cost center/account. 
• Supported workflow-based submission and review cycles by aligning access, inputs, and approvals for 
finance users across regions. 
• Automated data integration processes between Anaplan and finance source systems using Data Hub 
staging, improving refresh reliability and reducing manual effort. 
• Supported UAT planning, test execution, and documentation (release notes, user guides), ensuring 
readiness for production deployment.

Role: Associate Anaplan Model Builder – Production Support 
Tools & Technologies: Anaplan (Modules, Lists, UX Dashboards, Actions/Processes, ALM), 
Data Hub, Workflow, Jira, Excel 
Duration : Jun 2023 to Aug 2024 
Model	Description	
Supported business-critical Anaplan models used for FP&A budgeting/forecasting, revenue 
planning, cost tracking, and operational performance reporting. Responsible for day-to-day 
monitoring, issue resolution, data load support, and minor enhancements to ensure stable operations 
and accurate planning outputs for Finance and Business teams. 
Project	Contributions	
• Supported daily production activities by monitoring model health, resolving user queries, and 
ensuring planning inputs and reports were available as per business timelines. 
• Assisted in troubleshooting calculation issues, mapping mismatches, and access-related problems by 
reviewing module logic, system mappings, and import logs. 
• Supported periodic data refreshes for Actuals and master data (accounts, cost centers, business units, 
regions) through controlled import actions and processes. 
• Helped maintain Data Hub staging modules for structured loads and supported hub-to-spoke style 
data movement for reporting and planning consumption. 
• Supported month-end / forecast cycles by running standard processes such as Actuals load 
validation, version updates, and basic reconciliation checks against source extracts. 
• Delivered minor enhancements including adding new line items, updating dashboards, improving 
filters, creating saved views, and supporting usability improvements for end users. 
• Participated in UAT support by executing test cases, validating outputs, and tracking 
defects/enhancement requests through Jira. 
• Maintained support documentation such as runbooks/SOPs, recurring cycle steps, and known issue 
fixes to improve support consistency. 
 
 
 
 
Mohit Kumar 
 
Project Name : DataCore Validation (Banking Domain) 
Role : Manual Test Engineer 
Tools & Technologies : Manual Testing, Functional Testing, Regression Testing,  
Usability Testing, Web Testing 
Duration : Nov 2021 to May 2023 
Project Description The project focused on validating web and mobile applications to ensure functionality, usability,  
data accuracy, and overall system stability as per business and technical requirements. It involved  
end-to-end manual testing across multiple modules, including requirement analysis, test case preparation,  
test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and backend data validation using SQL.  
The objective was to deliver high-quality releases by identifying critical defects early, improving  
test coverage, and ensuring a smooth user experience across web, Android, and iOS platforms. 
 
Project Contribution 
• Analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and technical design documents to  
understand application functionality and define effective test scenarios.  
• Prepared and executed detailed manual test cases covering functional testing, usability testing,  
regression testing, smoke testing, and sanity testing.  
• Performed end-to-end testing on web and mobile applications, including Android and iOS platforms,  
to validate features against business requirements.  
• Identified, documented, and tracked defects using JIRA and Azure DevOps, ensuring timely 
communication with development and product teams.  
• Executed SQL queries for backend validation to verify database accuracy, data integrity, and  
consistency across application modules.  
• Participated in Agile ceremonies such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and 
retrospectives to support smooth delivery cycles.  
• Collaborated with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA team members to clarify 
requirements, resolve defects, and improve product quality.  
• Supported regression testing during release cycles to ensure existing functionality was not impacted  
by new changes.  
• Contributed to improving test coverage and defect detection by preparing reusable test scenarios  
and maintaining proper test documentation.  
• Assisted in UAT support by validating user-reported issues and ensuring fixes were properly tested 
before production release.
